verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י הַגּוֹרָל֙ לְמַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה כִּי־ ה֖וּא בְּכ֣וֹר יוֹסֵ֑ף לְמָכִיר֩ בְּכ֨וֹר מְנַשֶּׁ֜ה אֲבִ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֗ד כִּ֣י ה֤וּא הָיָה֙ אִ֣ישׁ מִלְחָמָ֔ה וַֽיְהִי־ ל֖וֹ הַגִּלְעָ֥ד וְהַבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hag·gō·w·rāl lə·maṭ·ṭêh mə·naš·šeh kî- hū bə·ḵō·wr yō·w·sêp̄ lə·mā·ḵîr bə·ḵō·wr mə·naš·šeh ’ă·ḇî hag·gil·‘āḏ kî hū hā·yāh ’îš mil·ḥā·māh way·hî- lōw hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·hab·bā·šān
verses.literal: Now this was the allotment for the tribe of Manasseh . . . as Joseph’s firstborn son namely for Machir the firstborn of Manasseh and father of the Gileadites who had received Gilead and Bashan because Machir was a man of war
verses.literalPt: Caiu também a sorte à tribo de Manassés, por ser ele o primogênito de José. Quanto a Maquir, primogênito de Manassés, pai de Gileade, pelo fato de ser homem de guerra, teve a Gileade e a Basã.

verses.original: וַ֠יְהִי לִבְנֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֥ה הַנּוֹתָרִים֮ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם֒ לִבְנֵ֨י אֲבִיעֶ֜זֶר וְלִבְנֵי־ חֵ֗לֶק וְלִבְנֵ֤י אַשְׂרִיאֵל֙ וְלִבְנֵי־ שֶׁ֔כֶם וְלִבְנֵי־ חֵ֖פֶר וְלִבְנֵ֣י שְׁמִידָ֑ע אֵ֠לֶּה בְּנֵ֨י מְנַשֶּׁ֧ה בֶּן־ יוֹסֵ֛ף הַזְּכָרִ֖ים לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî liḇ·nê mə·naš·šeh han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām liḇ·nê ’ă·ḇî·‘e·zer wə·liḇ·nê- ḥê·leq wə·liḇ·nê ’aś·rî·’êl wə·liḇ·nê- še·ḵem wə·liḇ·nê- ḥê·p̄er wə·liḇ·nê šə·mî·ḏā‘ ’êl·leh bə·nê mə·naš·šeh ben- yō·w·sêp̄ haz·zə·ḵā·rîm lə·miš·pə·ḥō·ṯām
verses.literal: So this allotment was for the rest of the descendants of Manasseh the clans of Abiezer Helek Asriel . . . Shechem . . . Hepher . . . and Shemida These are the other male descendants of the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph
verses.literalPt: Caiu a sorte aos mais filhos de Manassés segundo as suas famílias: aos filhos de Abiezer, e aos filhos de Heleque, e aos filhos de Asriel, e aos filhos de Siquém, e aos filhos de Hefer, e aos filhos de Semida. Estes foram os filhos de Manassés, filho de José, segundo as suas famílias.

verses.original: וְלִצְלָפְחָד֩ בֶּן־ חֵ֨פֶר בֶּן־ גִּלְעָ֜ד בֶּן־ מָכִ֣יר בֶּן־ מְנַשֶּׁ֗ה לֹא־ הָ֥יוּ ל֛וֹ בָּנִ֖ים כִּ֣י אִם־ בָּנ֑וֹת וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת בְּנֹתָ֔יו מַחְלָ֣ה וְנֹעָ֔ה חָגְלָ֥ה מִלְכָּ֖ה וְתִרְצָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·liṣ·lā·p̄ə·ḥāḏ ben- ḥê·p̄er ben- gil·‘āḏ ben- mā·ḵîr ben- mə·naš·šeh lō- hā·yū lōw bā·nîm kî ’im- bā·nō·wṯ wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ bə·nō·ṯāw maḥ·lāh wə·nō·‘āh ḥā·ḡə·lāh mil·kāh wə·ṯir·ṣāh
verses.literal: But Zelophehad son of Hepher the son of Gilead the son of Machir the son of Manasseh had . . . no sons but only daughters These are the names of his daughters Mahlah Noah Hoglah Milcah and Tirzah
verses.literalPt: Mas Zelofeade, filho de Hefer, filho de Gileade, filho de Maquir, filho de Manassés, não tinha filhos, mas somete filhas, cujos nomes são estes: Maalá, Noa, Hogla, Milca e Tirza.

verses.original: וַתִּקְרַ֡בְנָה לִפְנֵי֩ אֶלְעָזָ֨ר הַכֹּהֵ֜ן וְלִפְנֵ֣י׀ יְהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ בִּן־ נ֗וּן וְלִפְנֵ֤י הַנְּשִׂיאִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר יְהוָה֙ צִוָּ֣ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֔ה לָֽתֶת־ לָ֥נוּ נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ אַחֵ֑ינוּ וַיִּתֵּ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם אֶל־ פִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ נַֽחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ אֲחֵ֥י אֲבִיהֶֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiq·raḇ·nāh lip̄·nê ’el·‘ā·zār hak·kō·hên wə·lip̄·nê yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn wə·lip̄·nê han·nə·śî·’îm lê·mōr Yah·weh ṣiw·wāh ’eṯ- mō·šeh lā·ṯeṯ- lā·nū na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ’a·ḥê·nū way·yit·tên lā·hem ’el- pî Yah·weh na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ’ă·ḥê ’ă·ḇî·hen
verses.literal: They approached . . . Eleazar the priest . . . Joshua son of Nun . . . and the leaders and said The LORD commanded Moses to give us an inheritance among our brothers So Joshua gave them an inheritance among their father’s brothers in keeping with the command of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Estas chegaram à presença do sacerdote Eleazar, e de Josué, filho de Num, e dos príncipes, dizendo: Jeová ordenou a Moisés que se nos desse uma herança entre nossos irmãos. Josué, segundo a ordem de Jeová, deu-lhes uma herança entre os irmãos do seu pai.

verses.original: וַיִּפְּל֥וּ חַבְלֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה עֲשָׂרָ֑ה לְבַ֞ד מֵאֶ֤רֶץ הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְהַבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֖ר מֵעֵ֥בֶר לַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip·pə·lū ḥaḇ·lê- mə·naš·šeh ‘ă·śā·rāh lə·ḇaḏ mê·’e·reṣ hag·gil·‘āḏ wə·hab·bā·šān ’ă·šer mê·‘ê·ḇer lay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Thus ten shares fell to Manasseh in addition to the land of Gilead and Bashan beyond the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Caíram a Manassés dez quinhões, afora a terra de Gileade e Basã, que está além do Jordão;

verses.original: כִּ֚י בְּנ֣וֹת מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה נָחֲל֥וּ נַחֲלָ֖ה בְּת֣וֹךְ בָּנָ֑יו וְאֶ֙רֶץ֙ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד הָיְתָ֥ה לִבְנֵֽי־ מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה הַנּֽוֹתָרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî bə·nō·wṯ mə·naš·šeh nā·ḥă·lū na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·wḵ bā·nāw wə·’e·reṣ hag·gil·‘āḏ hā·yə·ṯāh liḇ·nê- mə·naš·šeh han·nō·w·ṯā·rîm
verses.literal: because the daughters of Manasseh received an inheritance among his sons And the land of Gilead belonged to the rest of the sons of Manasseh
verses.literalPt: porque as filhas de Manassés receberam uma herança entre os filhos dele. A terra de Gileade pertencia aos outros filhos de Manassés.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֤י גְבוּל־ מְנַשֶּׁה֙ מֵֽאָשֵׁ֔ר הַֽמִּכְמְתָ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ פְּנֵ֣י שְׁכֶ֑ם וְהָלַ֤ךְ הַגְּבוּל֙ אֶל־ הַיָּמִ֔ין אֶל־ יֹשְׁבֵ֖י עֵ֥ין תַּפּֽוּחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḡə·ḇūl- mə·naš·šeh mê·’ā·šêr ham·miḵ·mə·ṯāṯ ’ă·šer ‘al- pə·nê šə·ḵem wə·hā·laḵ hag·gə·ḇūl ’el- hay·yā·mîn ’el- yō·šə·ḇê ‘ên tap·pū·aḥ
verses.literal: Now the border of Manasseh went from Asher to Michmethath near . . . Shechem then southward . . . to include the inhabitants of En-tappuah
verses.literalPt: Foi o termo de Manassés desde Aser até Micmetate, que está defronte de Siquém; e estendeu-se pela direita até os que habitam En-Tapua.

verses.original: לִמְנַשֶּׁ֕ה הָיְתָ֖ה אֶ֣רֶץ תַּפּ֑וּחַ וְתַפּ֛וּחַ אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לִבְנֵ֥י אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: lim·naš·šeh hā·yə·ṯāh ’e·reṣ tap·pū·aḥ wə·ṯap·pū·aḥ ’el- gə·ḇūl mə·naš·šeh liḇ·nê ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: The region of Tappuah belonged to Manasseh but Tappuah itself on the border of Manasseh belonged to Ephraim
verses.literalPt: A terra de Tapua ficou pertencendo a Manassés; mas Tapua, junto ao termo de Manassés, pertencia aos filhos de Efraim.

verses.original: וְיָרַ֣ד הַגְּבוּל֩ נַ֨חַל קָנָ֜ה נֶ֣גְבָּה לַנַּ֗חַל עָרִ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ לְאֶפְרַ֔יִם בְּת֖וֹךְ עָרֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וּגְב֤וּל מְנַשֶּׁה֙ מִצְּפ֣וֹן לַנַּ֔חַל וַיְהִ֥י תֹצְאֹתָ֖יו הַיָּֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yā·raḏ hag·gə·ḇūl na·ḥal qā·nāh neḡ·bāh lan·na·ḥal ‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh lə·’ep̄·ra·yim bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘ā·rê mə·naš·šeh ū·ḡə·ḇūl mə·naš·šeh miṣ·ṣə·p̄ō·wn lan·na·ḥal way·hî ṯō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw hay·yām·māh
verses.literal: From there the border continued southward to the Brook of Kanah There were cities . . . belonging to Ephraim among the cities of Manasseh but the border of Manasseh was on the north side of the brook and ended . . . at the Sea
verses.literalPt: Desceu o termo desta até a torrente de Caná, para o sul da mesma. A Efraim pertenciam estas cidades entre as de Manassés. O termo de Manassés estava ao norte da torrente, e os seus extremos chegaram ao mar:

verses.original: נֶ֣גְבָּה לְאֶפְרַ֗יִם וְצָפ֙וֹנָה֙ לִמְנַשֶּׁ֔ה וַיְהִ֥י הַיָּ֖ם גְּבוּל֑וֹ וּבְאָשֵׁר֙ יִפְגְּע֣וּן מִצָּפ֔וֹן וּבְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר מִמִּזְרָֽח׃
verses.transliteration: neḡ·bāh lə·’ep̄·ra·yim wə·ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh lim·naš·šeh way·hî hay·yām gə·ḇū·lōw ū·ḇə·’ā·šêr yip̄·gə·‘ūn miṣ·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ū·ḇə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār mim·miz·rāḥ
verses.literal: Ephraim’s territory was to the south and Manasseh’s was to the north having the Sea as its border and adjoining Asher on the north and Issachar on the east
verses.literalPt: ao sul era de Efraim, ao norte era de Manassés, e o mar era o seu termo; estenderam-se até Aser, ao norte, e até Issacar, ao oriente.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֨י לִמְנַשֶּׁ֜ה בְּיִשָּׂשכָ֣ר וּבְאָשֵׁ֗ר בֵּית־ שְׁאָ֣ן וּ֠בְנוֹתֶיהָ וְיִבְלְעָ֨ם וּבְנוֹתֶ֜יהָ וְֽאֶת־ יֹשְׁבֵ֧י דֹ֣אר וּבְנוֹתֶ֗יהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֤י עֵֽין־ דֹּר֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֤י תַעְנַךְ֙ וּבְנֹתֶ֔יהָ וְיֹשְׁבֵ֥י מְגִדּ֖וֹ וּבְנוֹתֶ֑יהָ שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת הַנָּֽפֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî lim·naš·šeh bə·yiś·śā·š·ḵār ū·ḇə·’ā·šêr bêṯ- šə·’ān ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·yiḇ·lə·‘ām ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·’eṯ- yō·šə·ḇê ḏōr ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·yō·šə·ḇê ‘ên- dōr ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā wə·yō·šə·ḇê ṯa‘·naḵ ū·ḇə·nō·ṯe·hā wə·yō·šə·ḇê mə·ḡid·dōw ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā šə·lō·šeṯ han·nā·p̄eṯ
verses.literal: Within Issachar and Asher Manasseh was assigned Beth-shean Ibleam - Dor (that is, Naphath Endor - Taanach and Megiddo each with their surrounding settlements
verses.literalPt: Tinha Manassés em Issacar e em Aser a Bete-Seã e suas vilas, e a Ibleão e suas vilas, e aos habitantes de Dor e suas vilas, e aos habitantes de En-Dor e suas vilas, e aos habitantes de Taanaque e suas vilas, e aos habitantes de Megido e suas vilas, a saber, os três outeiros.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א יָכְלוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לְהוֹרִ֖ישׁ אֶת־ הֶֽעָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֑לֶּה וַיּ֙וֹאֶל֙ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֔י לָשֶׁ֖בֶת בָּאָ֥רֶץ הַזֹּֽאת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yā·ḵə·lū bə·nê mə·naš·šeh lə·hō·w·rîš ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm hā·’êl·leh way·yō·w·’el hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî lā·še·ḇeṯ bā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ
verses.literal: But the descendants of Manasseh were unable . . . to occupy these cities because the Canaanites were determined to stay in this land
verses.literalPt: Contudo, os filhos de Manassés não puderam desapossar os habitantes daquelas cidades, mas o cananeus persistiram em habitar nessa terra.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִ֗י כִּ֤י חָֽזְקוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּתְּנ֥וּ אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י לָמַ֑ס וְהוֹרֵ֖שׁ לֹ֥א הוֹרִישֽׁוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî kî ḥā·zə·qū bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yit·tə·nū ’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî lā·mas wə·hō·w·rêš lō hō·w·rî·šōw
verses.literal: However when the Israelites . . . grew stronger they put the Canaanites to forced labor but they failed to drive them out completely
verses.literalPt: Quando os filhos de Israel se tornaram fortes, sujeitaram os cananeus a trabalhos forçados e não os desapossaram de todo.

verses.original: וַֽיְדַבְּרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף אֶת־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ לֵאמֹ֑ר מַדּוּעַ֩ נָתַ֨תָּה לִּ֜י נַחֲלָ֗ה גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ וְחֶ֣בֶל אֶחָ֔ד וַֽאֲנִ֣י עַם־ רָ֔ב עַ֥ד אֲשֶׁר־ עַד־ כֹּ֖ה בֵּֽרְכַ֥נִי יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·ḏab·bə·rū bə·nê yō·w·sêp̄ ’eṯ- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lê·mōr mad·dū·a‘ nā·ṯat·tāh lî na·ḥă·lāh gō·w·rāl ’e·ḥāḏ wə·ḥe·ḇel ’e·ḥāḏ wa·’ă·nî ‘am- rāḇ ‘aḏ ’ă·šer- ‘aḏ- kōh bê·rə·ḵa·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then the sons of Joseph said to Joshua . . . Why have you given us only . . . one portion as an inheritance We have many people because the LORD has blessed us abundantly
verses.literalPt: Falaram os filhos de José a Josué, dizendo: Por que me deste apenas uma sorte e um quinhão por herança, sendo eu um povo grande, porquanto até aqui Jeová me tem abençoado?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ אִם־ עַם־ רַ֤ב אַתָּה֙ עֲלֵ֣ה לְךָ֣ הַיַּ֔עְרָה וּבֵרֵאתָ֤ לְךָ֙ שָׁ֔ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ הַפְּרִזִּ֖י וְהָֽרְפָאִ֑ים כִּֽי־ אָ֥ץ לְךָ֖ הַר־ אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’im- ‘am- raḇ ’at·tāh ‘ă·lêh lə·ḵā hay·ya‘·rāh ū·ḇê·rê·ṯā lə·ḵā šām bə·’e·reṣ hap·pə·riz·zî wə·hā·rə·p̄ā·’îm kî- ’āṣ lə·ḵā har- ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: Joshua answered them If you have so many people that the hill country of Ephraim is too small for you go to the forest and clear for yourself an area in the land of the Perizzites and the Rephaim
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Josué: Se tu és povo grande, sobe ao bosque e ali corta para ti lugar, na terra dos ferezeus e dos refains, desde que a região montanhosa de Efraim te é estreita demais.

verses.original: וַיֹּֽאמְרוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לֹֽא־ יִמָּ֥צֵא לָ֖נוּ הָהָ֑ר וְרֶ֣כֶב בַּרְזֶ֗ל בְּכָל־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַיֹּשֵׁ֣ב בְּאֶֽרֶץ־ הָעֵ֔מֶק לַֽאֲשֶׁ֤ר בְּבֵית־ שְׁאָן֙ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְלַֽאֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּעֵ֥מֶק יִזְרְעֶֽאל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū bə·nê yō·w·sêp̄ lō- yim·mā·ṣê lā·nū hā·hār wə·re·ḵeḇ bar·zel bə·ḵāl hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî hay·yō·šêḇ bə·’e·reṣ- hā·‘ê·meq la·’ă·šer bə·ḇêṯ- šə·’ān ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·hā wə·la·’ă·šer bə·‘ê·meq yiz·rə·‘el
verses.literal: The hill country is not enough for us they . . . replied and all the Canaanites who live in the valley have iron chariots both in Beth-shean with its towns and in the Valley of Jezreel
verses.literalPt: Tornaram os filhos de José: A região montanhosa não nos basta; e todos os cananeus que habitam na terra do vale têm carros de ferro, tanto os que estão em Bete-Seã e suas vilas, como os que estão no vale de Jezreel.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יוֹסֵ֔ף לְאֶפְרַ֥יִם וְלִמְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לֵאמֹ֑ר עַם־ רַ֣ב אַתָּ֗ה וְכֹ֤חַ גָּדוֹל֙ לָ֔ךְ לֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ גּוֹרָ֥ל אֶחָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- bêṯ yō·w·sêp̄ lə·’ep̄·ra·yim wə·lim·naš·šeh lê·mōr ‘am- raḇ ’at·tāh wə·ḵō·aḥ gā·ḏō·wl lāḵ lō- yih·yeh lə·ḵā gō·w·rāl ’e·ḥāḏ
verses.literal: So Joshua said to the house of Joseph to Ephraim and Manasseh . . . “You have many . . . people and great strength You shall not have . . . just one allotment
verses.literalPt: Falou Josué à casa de José, isto é, a Efraim e a Manassés, dizendo: Tu és povo grande e tens grandes forças; não terás tão somente uma sorte,

verses.original: כִּ֣י הַ֤ר יִֽהְיֶה־ לָּךְ֙ כִּֽי־ יַ֣עַר ה֔וּא וּבֵ֣רֵאת֔וֹ וְהָיָ֥ה לְךָ֖ תֹּֽצְאֹתָ֑יו כִּֽי־ תוֹרִ֣ישׁ אֶת־ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י כִּ֣י רֶ֤כֶב בַּרְזֶל֙ ל֔וֹ כִּ֥י חָזָ֖ק הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî har yih·yeh- lāḵ kî- ya·‘ar hū ū·ḇê·rê·ṯōw wə·hā·yāh lə·ḵā tō·ṣə·’ō·ṯāw kî- ṯō·w·rîš ’eṯ- hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî kî re·ḵeḇ bar·zel lōw kî ḥā·zāq hū
verses.literal: because the hill country will be yours as well It is a forest clear it and its farthest limits will be yours Although the Canaanites have iron chariots and although they are strong you can drive them out
verses.literalPt: mas a região montanhosa será tua. Ainda que é bosque, cortá-lo-ás, e as suas extremidades serão tuas, porque desapossarás os cananeus, ainda que têm carros de ferro e ainda que são fortes.
